Enviroment:Trait.reasoning: These are the names of the biological traits or variables being tested in the statistical model.

interaction coefficient.reasoning: This is a statistical measure (the coefficient) quantifying the relationship between variables.

wald value.reasoning: This is a statistical test value (Wald statistic) used to assess the significance of the trait.

Pr(>wald).reasoning: This is a statistical measure (p-value) indicating the probability of the observed result.
